name: hangul-tools
description: Tooling for people who work in Korean with Claude Code, starting with guards against silent Hangul corruption in tool-call arguments.

plugins.name: korean-toolarg-guard
plugins.description: Korean text in tool-call arguments can be silently corrupted into different-but-valid Hangul syllables. States the failure mode once per session and flags Korean-heavy MCP writes for re-reading.
